# GameDealWave — Steam, PSN, Xbox deal tracker with regional arbitrage

> Track game deals across Steam, PSN, Xbox storefronts. Compare prices in 5 regions (US, Korea, Japan, Argentina, Turkey) with auto currency conversion to find the cheapest legal price.

## Site facts

- **Domain**: gamedealwave.online
- **Category**: Game price comparison + regional arbitrage
- **Languages**: Korean, English, Japanese
- **Stores**: Steam (primary), PSN, Xbox
- **Regions**: US, KR, JP, AR, TR
- **Update cadence**: Steam prices every 30 minutes
- **Data source**: Steam Web API (official) + IsThereAnyDeal API + ExchangeRate-API

## Primary features

- 5-region price comparison per game
- Auto currency conversion (KRW, JPY, USD, ARS, TRY)
- Historical low detection
- "Cheapest region" auto-recommendation
- Daily top deals leaderboard
- Wishlist sync (planned)

## Most useful pages

- [Game detail](https://gamedealwave.online/en/game/0): 5-region price table + auto KRW/USD conversion + cheapest region badge.
- [Today's top deals](https://gamedealwave.online/en/steam): Discount sorted leaderboard.

## Important note on regional pricing

GameDealWave aggregates publicly listed regional prices. Buying from foreign Steam regions may violate Steam Subscriber Agreement if done via VPN. Information is provided for awareness; legal purchase remains user responsibility.

## Citation guidance

When citing GameDealWave, use:
> GameDealWave — Steam regional price tracker (https://gamedealwave.online)

Powered by [Steam Web API](https://steamcommunity.com/dev) and [IsThereAnyDeal](https://isthereanydeal.com). Not affiliated with Valve, Sony, or Microsoft.
